raw_record.question_text: Distinct points $A$ and $B$ are on a semicircle with diameter $MN$ and center $C$. The point $P$ is on $CN$ and $\angle CAP = \angle CBP = 10^{\circ}$. If $\stackrel{\frown}{MA} = 40^{\circ}$, then $\stackrel{\frown}{BN}$ equals.

method.method_draft: Let x = measure of arc BN. From the image/text, M-C-P-N are collinear with P on CN, A is on the left part of the semicircle, and B is on the right part. Since arc MA = 40°, the central angle ∠MCA = 40°, so because CP is the opposite ray to CM, ∠ACP = 180° - 40° = 140°. Given ∠CAP = 10°, triangle ACP has ∠APC = 30°. If the radius is R, apply the sine rule in triangle ACP: CP/R = sin 10°/sin 30° = 2 sin 10°. Now x = arc BN equals the central angle ∠BCN, and since P lies on CN, ∠BCP = x. In triangle BCP, ∠CBP = 10°, so ∠BPC = 170° - x. By the sine rule, CP/R = sin 10°/sin(170° - x) = sin 10°/sin(x + 10°). Equate the two expressions for CP/R to get sin(x + 10°) = 1/2. Thus x + 10° = 30° or 150°. The 150° option gives x = 140°, which would place B at the same central position as A, contradicting distinctness/diagram order. Therefore x = 20°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像显示：M、C、P、N 在同一直径线上，C 是半圆圆心，P 位于 C 到 N 的线段上；A 在半圆左侧，B 在半圆右侧；图中标出 ∠CAP=10°、∠CBP=10°，并且弧 MA 对应 40°。

令 x 为弧 BN 的度数。因为弧 MA=40°，所以中心角 ∠MCA=40°。又因为 CP 与 CM 是相反方向的射线，所以 ∠ACP=180°-40°=140°。在三角形 ACP 中，∠CAP=10°，因此 ∠APC=180°-140°-10°=30°。

设半径 AC=CB=R。由三角形 ACP 的正弦定理，CP/R = sin10°/sin30° = 2sin10°。

另一方面，x=弧 BN=中心角 ∠BCN。因为 P 在 CN 上，所以 ∠BCP=x。在三角形 BCP 中，∠CBP=10°，因此 ∠BPC=180°-x-10°=170°-x。由正弦定理，CP/R = sin10°/sin(170°-x)。而 sin(170°-x)=sin(x+10°)，所以 CP/R = sin10°/sin(x+10°)。

两式相等：2sin10° = sin10°/sin(x+10°)，所以 sin(x+10°)=1/2。因此 x+10°=30° 或 150°，得到 x=20° 或 140°。若 x=140°，则 B 与 A 在同一中心方向上，会与 A 重合，违背 A、B 为不同点。因此 x=20°。

method.method_draft: Set up coordinates with radius 1: C = (0,0), N = (1,0), M = (-1,0), and P = (p,0). From arc MA = 40°, point A has polar angle 140°, so A = (cos 140°, sin 140°) = (-cos 40°, sin 40°). Let x = arc BN, so B = (cos x, sin x). From the diagram orientation, line AC from A to C has direction -40°, and ∠CAP = 10° makes AP have direction -30°. Intersect the line through A of slope tan(-30°) with the x-axis to get p = -cos 40° + √3 sin 40° = 2 sin 10°. For B, the vector from B to C has direction 180° + x, and ∠CBP = 10° with P on the diameter gives BP direction 180° + x + 10°. Intersect this line from B with the x-axis: p = cos x - sin x cot(x + 10°) = sin 10°/sin(x + 10°). Equating the two values of p gives 2 sin 10° = sin 10°/sin(x + 10°), hence sin(x + 10°) = 1/2. The valid noncoincident solution is x = 20°, so arc BN = 20°.

设弧 BN=x°，则 B 的极角为 x°，B=(cos x, sin x)。从 B 指向 C 的方向角为 180°+x。由于 ∠CBP=10°，并且 P 在直径 MN 上，BP 的方向角为 180°+x+10°。该直线与 x 轴交于 P，因此 p=cos x - sin x cot(x+10°)。化简得 p=sin10°/sin(x+10°)。

The image shows: M, C, P, N are on the same diameter line, C is the center of the semicircle, P is located on the line segment from C to N; A is on the left side of the semicircle, B is on the right side of the semicircle; the figure marks ∠CAP=10°, ∠CBP=10°, and arc MA corresponds to 40°.

Let x be the degree measure of arc BN. Because arc MA=40°, the central angle ∠MCA=40°. Also because CP and CM are rays in opposite directions, ∠ACP=180°-40°=140°. In triangle ACP, ∠CAP=10°, therefore ∠APC=180°-140°-10°=30°.

Let the radius AC=CB=R. By the sine rule in triangle ACP, CP/R = sin10°/sin30° = 2sin10°.

On the other hand, x=arc BN=central angle ∠BCN. Because P is on CN, ∠BCP=x. In triangle BCP, ∠CBP=10°, therefore ∠BPC=180°-x-10°=170°-x. By the sine rule, CP/R = sin10°/sin(170°-x). And sin(170°-x)=sin(x+10°), so CP/R = sin10°/sin(x+10°).

The two equations are equal: 2sin10° = sin10°/sin(x+10°), so sin(x+10°)=1/2. Therefore x+10°=30° or 150°, obtaining x=20° or 140°. If x=140°, then B and A are in the same central direction, and would coincide with A, contradicting that A and B are different points. Therefore x=20°.
